summary: All 31 OpenSSL fuzz harnesses failed with BUILD_ERROR. Every harness includes 'fuzzer.h', an OpenSSL internal header that defines FuzzerTestOneInput/FuzzerInitialize. This header is not a standalone file — it requires the full OpenSSL build environment (generated by ./Configure). The harnesses are tightly coupled to OpenSSL's custom build system and cannot be compiled against raw source.
failure_reason: All 31 harnesses: 'fuzzer.h' file not found — OpenSSL's internal fuzz framework header requires built source tree
key_findings: OpenSSL's 31 OSS-Fuzz harnesses all use FuzzerTestOneInput (project wrapper), not LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput directly
All harnesses depend on fuzzer.h which requires the full OpenSSL build (./Configure + make)
Even if compiled, these harnesses test high-level crypto protocols (TLS, QUIC, X.509) that are extremely challenging for KLEE due to state explosion
